FN-9QI7PBB-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 323
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Randy Price
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/23/2024
Senate Bill 323 as passed the Senate would prohibit a county commission from distributing the
proceeds from certain county tobacco taxes to certain entities and would provide for such
proceeds to be deposited into escrow for appropriation to another entity until January 1, 2026.
This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
